inlines.v: ADMEAS'URE, verb transitive admezh'ur. [ad and measure. See Measure.] 1. To measure or ascertain dimensions, size or capacity; used for measure. 2. To apportion; to assign to each claimant has right; as, to admeasure dower or common of pasture.
